formation: The characters 史 (history), 吏 (government official), 使 (cause; use; instruct), and 事 (matter; work; affair) are all etymologically related and all derive from the same ancient character, depicting a hand (又) holding a container for writing utensils.

components.note: 亻 is a component form of 人.
Depicts a hand holding a container for writing utensils.
